Hi Marta — appreciate the fast turnaround. I reviewed the uploaded W-8BEN-E and the bank letter. A couple of administrative items before we can issue PO# SA-2027-153:

1) Signatory verification: please confirm the signatory is the CFO or an authorized officer. If the signer is a delegated signatory, send a short delegation affidavit (one paragraph) and the signer's corporate ID.
2) Tax ID mapping: the tax ID in section 9 matches our international registry checks, but please add the country code next to the number (helps downstream reconciliation).
3) Invoice remit: please confirm the remit-to email and whether you accept ACH in USD (we can provide bank routing details once PO is issued).

If you can provide items 1–3 by end of day tomorrow, procurement will issue a provisional PO (SA-2027-153-PROV). Once we receive the delegation affidavit (if needed) and the updated W-8BEN-E with country code, we'll finalize the PO and notify accounts-payable to expect invoices.

For audit trail: I've created a HubSpot deal and procurement ticket — links here: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/SA-4782 and ticket PR-8853.
